REMITTITUR FILED THE COURT FINDS THAT RETALIATION UNDER CIVIL CODE 1942.5 IS NOT A DEFENSE TO AN ELLIS ACT EVICTION. THE STATUTE IS CLEAR ON ITS FACE AS TO THE AVAILABLE DEFENSES AND TO HOLD OTHERWISE WOULD INTRUDE IMPERMISSIBLY ON A LANDLORD'S ABSOLUTE RIGHT TO EXIT THE RESIDENTIAL RENTAL BUSINESS. ACCORDINGLY, THE JUDGMENT IS AFFIRMED.
THE REMITTITUR JUDGMENT ENTRY IS FOR THE (FIRST) APPEAL FILED ON 2-11-99. SECOND APPEAL IS STILL OUTSTANDING.
